name: How long does a typical interior home renovation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical interior home renovation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an interior home renovation varies significantly based on the scope and complexity of the project. A small bathroom refresh might take a few weeks, while a major kitchen remodel could extend to several months. Whole-house renovations can take six months to a year or more. Factors like material availability, unforeseen structural issues, and permit processing times can also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule at the outset.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary; a small renovation can be weeks, a major one several months or longer.
